name: z80next
description: z80live serverless : compilation Z80 côté client (WASM), base SQLite portable, API CRUD tout-JS

scripts.build:wasm: FANTAMS_OUT_DIR=wasm FANTAMS_PUB_DIR=app/public/wasm bash fantams/build-wasm.sh && cp -f wasm/assemble.mjs app/public/wasm/assemble.mjs
scripts.build: npm run build:wasm && npm run build:app
scripts.dev:full: npm run build && PORT=3000 node --experimental-sqlite server/api.mjs
